messages:
olivia (oncall): sec-bot flagged an anomaly — spike in ephemeral tokens for svc-account 'ingest-worker-prod', multiple KMS decrypts observed from unfamiliar IPs. opening war room. tagging @mateo @priya @dan :rotating_light:
sec-bot: DETECTION eid-20260320-07 — ephemeral-token-anomaly threshold exceeded (50/min). Top src IPs: 34.210.12.8, 52.23.87.101. Detected protoPayload.methods: GenerateAccessToken, Decrypt.
mateo: on it. can someone pull audit logs 2026-03-20T06:35Z -> 06:55Z and filter for iam/credentials and sts assume events?
priya: running a quick read now
priya: query I ran:
```
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:("GenerateAccessToken" "AssumeRole" "GetAccessToken")' --start-time "2026-03-20T06:35:00Z" --end-time "2026-03-20T06:55:00Z" --format json
```
priya: ~48 matching entries. majority show svc-account ingest-worker-prod assumed from the two IPs; see multiple kms.decrypt for object b302f7a9
dan: network is blocking the two IPs at the edge now, pushing denylist to WAF and firewall.
mateo: containment checklist (short):
- revoke active ephemeral tokens for ingest-worker-prod
- suspend service account or remove external trust for STS
- block IPs at edge
- export and lock audit logs to secure bucket
- rotate any KMS keys if we observe unauthorized unwraps
olivia (oncall): performing revoke step 1 (calling IAM revoke-token API)
sec-bot: revoke call returned success — 46 tokens invalidated for ingest-worker-prod
priya: exported full JSON of relevant audit entries to gs://redwood-sec-ev/ephemeral-abuse/1971234567/ ; ACL set to security-only. uploaded a small timeline.md and md5 manifest.
mateo: IOC list (short): svc-account: ingest-worker-prod, IPs: 34.210.12.8, 52.23.87.101, object id: b302f7a9, user-agent: python-requests/2.28
jessica: compliance looped in — please include KMS decrypt object IDs; I'll triage for potential PII access and prep notification checklist if needed.
dan: created incident shell doc draft https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-0320-ephemeral (private). correlating with vuln tracker and CI audit.
mateo: quick forensics note — no evidence of lateral movement beyond the storage decrypts we see. primary impact appears to be unauthorized token minting + targeted decrypts. recommend rotating service-account keys, tightening STS trust (restrict source IPs / external id), and preserving all logs for 90 days.
priya: found operator trace — tokens appear minted by a runway-ci job that used a human operator key. opening a CI team ticket for secrets exposure.
olivia (oncall): containment actions completed: denylist applied, tokens revoked, trust policy locked down. still validating KMS key integrity and decrypt counts.
priya: saving a short artifact list in the incident folder: audit.json, timeline.md, iocs.txt, ksm-decrypts.csv
mateo: assigning next tasks: forensic image -> @alex, RBAC policy review -> @samir, CI secrets audit -> @leah
olivia (oncall): preparing handoff to night oncall. include timeline, artifact locations, actions taken, and watchlist (svc-account + two IPs + object id). assigning @karen for 03:00 UTC watch.
karen: taking handoff. will monitor for 6h and escalate on any spike. please add me to the artifacts bucket and the doc.
olivia (oncall): karen added to ACLs. created post-incident task list in the doc.
olivia (oncall): post-incident follow-ups: full forensic capture, KMS key policy review, CI secrets rotation + audit, RBAC drift detection across envs, postmortem draft.
mateo: noted. will produce a short remediation PR for stricter STS trust and addon alert rules for ephemeral token rate.
olivia (oncall): closing war room for now — incident remains open for follow-up. handoff notes and artifacts saved. :white_check_mark:
